Hi Sofia,

It was great to meet you at the SaaS Summit last week — I enjoyed our conversation about EdgeAI's low-latency inference requirements for realtime customer support. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: real-time intent classification + short-response generation in the support widget
- Current pain: inconsistent latency and high token cost at peak traffic
- Priority/timing: pilot in Q2 if procurement aligns

I've attached a short one-pager on Redwood Inference that covers dedicated and hosted options, plus our typical pilot approach. If it makes sense, I'd love to set up a 30-minute discovery to go over architecture and cost targets — my calendar: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/30min

Are you available next week (Feb 8-11) for a call? If procurement needs to be looped in early, happy to include them.

Thanks,
